evidence.description: Direct access to a singleton service via .shared

candidates.explanation: The `User` struct directly accesses the `EcosiaAuthUIStateProvider.shared` singleton to retrieve the `seedCount` property, creating a hard-coded dependency on a global singleton service.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Mutable global static variable 'shared' without isolation

candidates.explanation: The `User` struct contains a `shared` static property that is a mutable `var`. This global state is modified via `didSet` (which calls `save()`) and is accessed/modified without any visible actor isolation or synchronization mechanisms, creating a risk of data races.
candidates.title: Unprotected Mutable Global or Static State

evidence.description: Unstructured Task.detached without cancellation or lifecycle management

candidates.explanation: The `save()` method initiates an unstructured `Task.detached` to perform file I/O. This task has no visible cancellation mechanism or lifecycle management, and it captures the `user` instance, which could lead to issues if the operation outlives the intended scope.
candidates.title: Unstructured Concurrency Without Appropriate Lifecycle Management

evidence.description: Force unwrap of a date calculation

candidates.explanation: The `showsReferralSpotlight` property force-unwraps the result of `Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -3, to: .init())!`, which is not guaranteed to be non-nil by the visible code.
candidates.title: Unjustified Force Unwrapping
